title: Instrumental snapshot cards for release briefs — compact onboarding & pricing visuals
creator: Mina Torres
description: Create a compact, annotation-ready set of snapshot cards and onboarding overlays to be used across release notes, quickstart docs, and the marketing release brief. Focus scope: (1) new model tiles (compact and stacked variants), (2) deprecation state visuals with timeline badges and migration tips, (3) price-per-token and price-tier overlays including localized currency and tier badges, and (4) responsive screenshots for docs (desktop/tablet/mobile) and embedded social images. Deliverables must include annotated source frames, sliced PNG/JPEG exports at required sizes, and accessible text alternatives for each screenshot. Coordinate with PM and engineering to ensure pricing copy matches bill-of-materials from finance and that deprecation messaging links to migration guide.
acceptance_criteria: Set of 12 snapshot cards (4 new-model variants x 3 breakpoints) exported as 2x and 3x PNGs
3 deprecation-state cards with timeline overlay, recommended replacement CTA, and migration hint text
Localized price overlay for USD, EUR, JPY with correct currency symbols and rounded units
Annotated Figma source frames with redline spacing/grid tokens and text styles for docs team
Signed off by PM (Owen Patel) and Eng lead (Samir Kapoor) in review thread
All screenshots include alt-text drafts and an accessibility checklist
steps: Kickoff sync with PM/Eng to confirm model names, prices, and sunset dates (done 2026-03-11)
Create low-fi wireframe pack for stakeholder review
Iterate hi-fi frames with localized overlays and responsive states
Produce export slices and annotate tokens/measurements
Submit review PR for docs/assets and update Drive/Confluence links
Finalize assets, attach to release notes, and hand off to content localization
decisions: Use compact card layout (left-aligned badge + two-line meta) to save vertical space in release notes
Show both per-token rate and effective per-1k tokens rate; include parenthetical unit for international audiences
Deprecation badge color: amber for announced, red for sunset — chosen for contrast and accessibility
